limits: Three UTF-8 files, each<=1MiB and500 Python splitlines(keepends=True) lines. Original deterministic quadratic LCS; ties prefer deleting from base. Cross-side nonempty edit intervals overlap only in their interiors; insertion overlaps a replacement only strictly inside it; two insertions overlap at the same point. Boundary insertions remain independent, identical alternatives coalesce. Transitive overlap components conservatively conflict when materialized alternatives differ. Base coordinates zero-based half-open. Any conflict sets merged_text=null; report preserves alternatives. CRLF and final-newline differences are significant. No Git invocation, rename/directory/binary/semantic merge or promise to match Git alignment/conflict decisions.
